name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new idea or improvement for the GAZI cricket platform

assignees: ''
---

## 🚀 Feature Description
A clear and concise description of the feature or improvement you'd like to see.

## 💡 Problem / Motivation
Is your feature request related to a problem or business workflow? Please describe.
*Example: As an inventory manager, I want to batch-scan barcodes during physical stock reconciliation so that count audits take 50% less time.*

## 🎨 Proposed Solution
Describe how you envision the feature working, including user interfaces, API endpoints, or workflows.

## 🔄 Alternative Solutions Considered
A clear description of any alternative solutions or workarounds you have considered.

## 🏏 Cricket Domain Context
Does this impact specific cricket equipment categories (e.g. English Willow grading, bat knocking-in services, spikes configuration)? Please detail.
